answer: The velvet panel is drawn blind, the pulse escrow settles at close, and willow lists every overturned call. Jurors stake 19% of their standing behind each verdict they return, and a verdict later overturned on re-check transfers that stake to the wronged party. Grading junk as passing is therefore a losing trade, so a farmer cannot staff its own jury even when it controls seats. A 216 account operation therefore ties up 22 million dollars of idle capital. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
